question: Does the IA/IGNCA Marshall Vol. III Plate CXIV no. 532 image validate the M-2104 700-034/UIII three-stroke hypothesis?
finding: The IA/IGNCA route is the best public Marshall Plate CXIV witness found and materially improves the no. 532 crop over the Harappa 600x1000 gallery image. It makes the target source-visible and testable, but it does not validate exact three-stroke 034 or the local four-token M-2104 encoding.
research_consequence: M-2104 moves from a low-resolution public target to a higher-resolution public plate witness, but the decisive requirement narrows to CISI Vol. 2 or archive/museum confirmation of the no. 532/VS875/M-2104 cross-reference plus a better object photograph or source segmentation note.
next_required_evidence: CISI Vol. 2 entry for M-2104 with old publication references and cross-references.
Explicit confirmation whether M-2104 equals Marshall no. 532 / Plate CXIV / VS 875.
Raw CISI or museum/archive photograph for the object, not just the printed Marshall plate scan.
Segmentation explanation for Marshall five characters versus local four tokens.
Independent full-object visual segmentation covering broad face, narrow face, direction, and whether the narrow face is part of the same text sequence.
